name_en: Distribution of Free Bicycles to Class 11 Students
department: Backward Classes, Most Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit: Boys and girls in Class 11 at government, aided and partly aided schools get a free bicycle. Income and community do not matter.

other: Must be in Class 11 (+1) at a Government, Government Aided or partially aided school
Free bus pass holders can also get it
Students who live in a hostel inside the school, or in a residential school, cannot get it

evidence.quote: Bicycles are supplied to 11th standard students of Government, Government aided and partially aided schools irrespective of income and community.
Should be the students (Boys & Girls) of +1 in Government, Government aided and partially aided school
(this concession is applicable to the Free bus pass holders also.)
Students staying in the Hostels situated in the school premises and staying in Residential Schools are not eligible for getting free bi-cycles.
Officials to be contacted Concerned School Headmaster.
Officials to be contacted Concerned School Headmaster.

gaps: Source is the BC/MBC/DNC Welfare Department page; it says bicycles go to all Class 11 students 'irrespective of income and community', but does not name which department runs the scheme overall.
Source does not list documents or a formal application step; it only says to contact the school Headmaster.
Source page is undated; no G.O. number, helpline or Tamil name.
